title: Java Programming
headline: Learn Java step-by-step from zero to enterprise-grade placement readiness. Build strong mental models, write clean code, and practice interactively.
summary: Comprehensive 17-section curriculum designed for self-learners to master Java, OOP, Spring Boot, DSA, and technical interviews.
outcomes: Write clean, idiomatic Java applying OOP and modern design principles
Understand JVM memory, stack, heap, and garbage collection internals
Build production-grade REST APIs and microservices with Spring Boot
Solve data structure and algorithmic coding challenges with confidence
Ace placement and software engineering technical interview rounds

sections.title: Java Basics
sections.summary: Foundational programming from zero: syntax, variables, operators, conditionals, loops, methods, arrays, strings, and exceptions.

modules.title: Getting Started
modules.description: Understand how computers run code, the role of JVM, JDK, JRE, and dissect your first Java program.
learningObjectives: Master all core concepts of Getting Started
Solve hands-on practice problems in Getting Started
Prepare for placement interview questions on Getting Started

lessons.title: Java & The JVM

learningOutcomes: Understand WORA architecture

lessons.title: Install Java (Win & Mac)

modules.title: Variables & Data Types

lessons.title: Variables — Storing Information

Explain memory allocation for primitive variables

lessons.title: Java Data Types
lessons.summary: Explore Java's strong typing system, the 8 primitive data types vs reference types, and why strict types prevent runtime crashes.
learningOutcomes: Categorize Java's 8 primitive types
Understand why static typing guarantees safety

lessons.title: Integer Numbers — byte, short, int & long

lessons.title: char, boolean & String

Represent conditions in boolean without 1/0 confusion

lessons.title: Constants & final

lessons.title: Type Conversion & Casting

modules.title: Operators
modules.description: Arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise, assignment, and ternary operators with precedence rules.

Apply simple and compound assignment operators with implicit type casting safety
Evaluate relational and equality comparisons while distinguishing primitive values from object references
Combine complex conditions using logical AND, OR, and NOT with De Morgan's laws
Demystify pre and post increment/decrement operator mechanics with exact operand evaluation tracing
Leverage short-circuit evaluation to write safe defensive guards against NullPointerException and Division-by-Zero
Construct concise inline conditional expressions using the ternary operator
Resolve multi-operator expressions deterministically using operator precedence and associativity rules
Perform low-level binary manipulation using bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOT, and shift operators
Synthesize all operator categories to build robust business calculations and security validation logic

lessons.title: Arithmetic Operators — Doing Calculations
lessons.summary: Master fundamental arithmetic in Java (+, -, *, /, %), integer truncation, division by zero rules, and remainder calculations.
learningOutcomes: Perform precise arithmetic operations in Java
Prevent integer truncation bugs in division

lessons.title: Assignment & Compound Assignment

Avoid compilation pitfalls with implicit casting

lessons.title: Relational & Equality Operators

lessons.title: Ternary Operator

lessons.title: Operator Precedence & Expression Evaluation

learningOutcomes: Evaluate multi-operator expressions with complete certainty

lessons.title: Bitwise & Shift Operators

learningOutcomes: Perform binary-level calculations and bit masking

lessons.title: Operators — Final Challenge
